'nontrivial' = x occurs in t but is neither its leftmost nor its rightmost leaf (otherwise a projection is a model of every size, or x is absent and only n = 1 works)

meta.falsification: Any identity whose spectrum within 1..6 is neither {1} nor everything refutes H-C05-1.
meta.hypothesis: H-C05-1 (bold): every identity t = x has spectrum {1} or all positive integers - single identities cannot carve out arithmetic restrictions on the size of a model.
meta.methodology: For each nontrivial identity: SAT model existence for n = 1..6; exhaustive model enumeration with isomorphism rejection for n <= 3; record whether all enumerated models are quasigroups. Mirror images (t read right-to-left) are paired; their spectra must agree. (Larger n are enumerated, and n = 7..10 decided, only for restricted identities in EXP-C05-02.)
meta.question: Which sizes of finite magmas can satisfy a single invented identity t(x, y) = x?
